description: Give your AI assistant direct access to DataCamp's full catalog of courses, tutorials, projects, and exercises. Search by keyword, look up any course or exercise by ID, or retrieve summaries on demand—no sign-in required. Authenticate to unlock team admin: manage groups, members, and assignments. Run live reporting on progress, engagement, and adoption to track how learning is landing across your organization.
